history.summary: Spacious 1,302 sqft 3BR steps from Paya Lebar MRT interchange at $1,244 PSF — below the $1,304 URA median — in a district riding the Paya Lebar Central transformation. Strong location and value entry, tempered by a thin 31-txn appreciation series and ageing 1998 99-yr lease.
history.rating_rationale: $1,244 PSF is ~5% under the $1,304 URA median, the CC9 Paya Lebar interchange is 550m, and Paya Lebar Central (airbase relocation) is a concrete catalyst. 6.65% URA appreciation is attractive but rests on only 31 txns so treat as indicative; 1998 lease (~71yr) is the main drag.
catalysts: Paya Lebar Central commercial hub + airbase relocation land
